channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Roberta põe Lulinha como lobista de empresa do túnel de Santos
item.description: Roberta Luchsinger, under investigation by the Federal Police, revealed Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) as a lobbyist for the company involved in the Santos-Guarujá Tunnel project, a key initiative of Tarcísio de Freitas. The strained relationship between Roberta and Lulinha, tied to fraud allegations in the INSS and corruption schemes, sparked political debates and suspicions of undue influence in the project's bidding process.

item.title: O recorde de críticas a Lula nas redes após entrevista de Roberta Luchsinger
item.description: Roberta Luchsinger's interview on CNN Brasil triggered the highest spike of criticism against Lula on social media in 2026, with 37,587 negative mentions in one hour. The backlash included 14,833 references to the phrase 'Lula mentiroso' and increased negative mentions about Lulinha, the president's son. Luchsinger stated she intends to sign a plea bargain without sparing Lula or his son.

item.title: PT cobra TSE após mudanças em locais de votação
item.description: The PT requested that the TSE widely publicize changes to voting locations for the second round, affecting 2,033 electoral sections and approximately 592,000 voters. The coalition asked for greater transparency regarding these changes.

item.title: Quem está na frente para presidente no segundo turno? Veja resultado das últimas pesquisas com Lula e Flávio
item.description: One week before the 2026 runoff election, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leads with 47% of voting intentions, compared to 44.8% for President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), according to the Rali aggregator. The tool, developed by GLOBO and Instituto Locomotiva, compiles data from institutes such as Datafolha, Quaest, and Ipespe, along with government approval ratings.

item.title: PT aposta em atos descentralizados pela democracia com Emicida em SP e Caetano Veloso no Rio; Flávio Bolsonaro lota Avenida Paulista
item.description: The PT promotes decentralized rallies nationwide with support from artists like Emicida, Caetano Veloso, and Gilberto Gil to back Lula. Flávio Bolsonaro fills Paulista Avenue, while the Electoral Court reviews lawsuits questioning whether events are 'political concerts'. Lula has a limited schedule, with only a TV debate, as the campaign prioritizes organic and local mobilizations.

item.title: "O povo tá na rua defendendo direitos", diz Grass em ato da esquerda no DF
item.description: Leandro Grass (PT) participated in the 'Ato da Virada' at the Praça do Museu Nacional da República, in Brasília, a demonstration supporting Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's (PT) reelection in the 2026 elections. During the event, Grass emphasized popular mobilization in defense of social rights such as education, housing, and health, and stated that the Federal District has 'way, hope, and alternative'.

item.title: Estudantes retomam protagonismo em momento decisivo no país, diz UNE
item.description: Students take to the streets again to defend democracy, public education, and public universities, particularly with the second round of the presidential elections underway. The UNE highlights the risk of an authoritarian government and calls for improvements for low-income students.

item.title: A outra artista proibida de entrar no camarim de Lula durante a sabatina
item.description: Comedian Tatá Werneck and TV host Paulo Vieira were barred from visiting President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in the Globo backstage during the October 15 town hall. The network cited concerns about maintaining impartiality as the reason. The incident was shared by Paulo Vieira on social media.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro faz ato na Paulista com Tarcísio e Nikolas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) held a campaign rally on Paulista Avenue in São Paulo with governors Tarcísio de Freitas and Nikolas. During the event, he displayed a flag reading 'Out with Lula and Moraes,' criticizing President Lula and Justice Minister Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Motorista avança carro em ato pró-Lula e atropela homem de 67 anos em MG
item.description: At a pro-Lula rally in Belo Horizonte, a 45-year-old driver rammed into protesters, seriously injuring a 67-year-old man. He fled the scene but was arrested on attempted homicide charges, claiming he acted in self-defense after being pelted with bottles and cans by demonstrators.

item.title: Filho de Temer aparece em vídeo com adesivo de apoio a Lula
item.description: Michel Temer's youngest son, 17, was filmed wearing a pro-Lula sticker, going against his father Michel Temer's public endorsement of Flávio Bolsonaro. The video, recorded at Meretriz Bar in São Paulo, highlights growing political divergence within the Temer family.

item.title: Campanha de Lula traz depoimento da mãe de Paulo Gustavo sobre a pandemia
item.description: Lula's campaign will emotionally leverage the testimony of Dona Déa, mother of Paulo Gustavo, to criticize Bolsonaro's management during the pandemic. The video will air on social media and during prime time on Tuesday, highlighting the actor's death in 2021 after nearly two months hospitalized from Covid-19 complications.

item.title: Local de votação muda em mais de 4 000 seções no 2º turno; saiba como consultar
item.description: The Electoral Justice changed the voting location for 4,352 sections in the second round of the 2026 Elections, representing 0.87% of the 499,248 sections. The changes were motivated by factors such as damage caused by rains, reforms and infrastructure problems. Voters should check the new address through the e-Título app or the Electoral Self-Service on the TSE portal.

item.title: “Bomba na família Lula”, diz Flávio após entrevista de Roberta Luchsinger
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) commented on social media about the accusations made by lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger against Lula (PT) and his son, calling them a 'bomb in the Lula family'. Following Luchsinger's interview on CNN Brasil, Flávio emphasized the phrases 'liar and bad character' to describe Lula.

item.title: Entenda como WhatsApp virou arma poderosa na campanha eleitoral
item.description: WhatsApp has become a central tool in Brazilian electoral campaigns, leveraging trust among close contacts to spread political content in family, work and friendship groups. Experts point out that messages shared by known people are more effective than institutional advertising, as they bypass the critical self-awareness typical of traditional media. This behavior amplifies the spread of information, often without prior verification, substantially influencing opinions and electoral decisions.

item.title: A privatização dos Correios no governo Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Despite Flávio Bolsonaro's privatist profile, the postal service is unlikely to be privatized under his government, given the agency's dire financial situation. The decision depends on unresolved economic and political factors.

item.title: Congressistas acionam STF para pedir proteção a Roberta Luchsinger
item.description: Pro-government lawmakers filed a lawsuit at the STF requesting protection for lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger and her daughters, after she expressed fear for her safety and accused Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The letter, co-signed by Marcel Van Hattem, Zucco, and Bia Kicis, calls for investigations into alleged threats and protective measures under the Maria da Penha Law. Luchsinger, investigated for suspected influence peddling, stated she plans to strike a plea deal and will not spare political figures.

item.title: 3 de 14 clubes protestam contra proibição de bets em camisas
item.description: Three Brazilian Série A clubs wore protest messages on their jerseys against the ban on betting advertising. The temporary measure still needs congressional approval and Supreme Court analysis, with a likely ruling after the 2026 elections.

item.title: Cotado a ministro, Sachsida já entregou pacote de 200 propostas econômicas a Flávio
item.description: Adolfo Sachsida, former minister under Jair Bolsonaro and a likely pick for a role in Flávio Bolsonaro's team if he wins the 2026 election, has already delivered a package of 200 economic proposals to the senator, focusing on microeconomics, sector deregulation, and legislative measures. The information was disclosed in an exclusive article for subscribers.

item.title: Lisboa tem ato a favor de Lula com presença de Alceu Valença
item.description: Lula supporters gathered in Lisbon for the 'Caminhada da Virada', featuring Alceu Valença. The event highlighted Lula's stronger performance in Portugal, where he secured 52.45% of the vote against Flávio Bolsonaro's 38.57%.

item.title: Lula planejava anunciar PEC do passe livre em entrevista na Globo, mas...
item.description: Lula announced, 10 days before the second round, a constitutional amendment bill to ensure free weekend public transport in cities with collective transport. The campaign's initial strategy was to reveal the proposal during an exclusive interview with Globo. The measure aims to attract voters with social proposals at the decisive moment of the election.

item.title: Neymar cita filhos de Luana Piovani após crítica da atriz nas redes
item.description: Neymar and Luana Piovani exchanged criticism on social media after the actress mocked the player's personal life and linked him to Flávio Bolsonaro. The discussion included references to legal proceedings and the actress's children, intensifying the backlash surrounding a dispute ongoing since 2024.

item.title: A mensagem de mau gosto de Vorcaro após Lula correr risco de vida em cirurgia no cérebro
item.description: Daniel Vorcaro was received by Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva at the Palace of the Planalto on December 4, 2024, after previous failed attempts. According to messages extracted by the Federal Police from the phone of the owner of Banco Master, the president did not earn Vorcaro's sympathy. The article is exclusive to newspaper subscribers.

item.title: Justiça manda Meta reativar contas de estudantes bloqueadas no Instagram
item.description: Federal Court ordered Meta to restore four student entity accounts blocked on Instagram in Rio Grande do Sul, following a lawsuit by MPF and Saju/UFRGS. The suspensions occurred after posts calling for pro-Lula demonstrations.

item.title: Como consultar local de votação após TSE mudar quase 5 mil seções eleitorais de endereço
item.description: The TSE changed 4,864 polling stations for the 2026 second round, citing weather and safety concerns. Voters should check updated addresses via the TSE website or e-Título app before voting on October 25. The runoff only covers executive positions.

item.title: A 'ponte segura' aos irmãos Batista em eventual vitória de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Batista brothers, close to Lula, may face risks if Flávio Bolsonaro takes office in 2026. A 'safe bridge' strategy is being considered to protect J&F group interests in case of a government shift. The article highlights the interplay between economic power and politics in the Brazilian electoral landscape.

item.title: Plebiscito sobre mudança em cidades do PR com votação em urna será inédito
item.description: On October 25th, voters in Chopinzinho and São João (PR) will vote in an unprecedented plebiscite to decide if the Alto Mirim community will be transferred from Chopinzinho to São João. The consultation, held after the presidential election, marks the first time a desmembramento referendum is conducted in voting machines in Brazil.

item.title: Lula diz “desconhecer inteiramente” acusações de Roberta Luchsinger
item.description: President Lula denied having contact with lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger and claimed to be unaware of the accusations she made to CNN Brasil. The Presidency deemed the timing of the statements suspicious, released a week before the second round of the 2026 elections. The case underscores the ongoing political polarization in Brazil.

item.title: Campanha de Lula exibirá depoimento de Dona Déa sobre morte de Paulo Gustavo: 'Flávio é retrocesso'
item.description: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's campaign recorded a statement from Déa Lúcia, mother of the late actor Paulo Gustavo, who died in 2021 from complications of Covid-19 before being vaccinated. The video will be released on his social media and in his next TV electoral program, one week before the second round of the 2026 elections. Paulo Gustavo's mother claims that Governor Flávio Dino represents backwardness, although the content appears to focus on criticism of the federal government over its pandemic management.

item.title: Tarcísio lidera em engajamentos pró-Flávio entre governadores. Veja ranking
item.description: The governor of São Paulo, Tarcísio de Freitas, leads the ranking of social media engagement in favor of Flávio Bolsonaro among allied state governors of the PL, with 30 posts and 2.4 million engagements. Second place goes to the elected governor of Minas Gerais, Cleitinho, with 25 publications and 2.2 million engagements. Among elected federal deputies, Nikolas Ferreira leads with 19 million engagements across 61 posts.

item.title: Em áudio do caso Master-BRB, advogado diz que Vorcaro tinha ‘apoio do presidente’ e ‘do PT’
item.description: Messages found on Daniel Vorcaro's phone show that lawyer Walfrido Warde told the owner of Banco Master in March 2025 that Globo was trying to break his internal support within the PT and the president. The acquisition of 58% of Banco Master by BRB depended on approval from the Central Bank, led by someone Vorcaro expected to influence through Lula. The conversations indicate direct contact between the lawyer and the Presidential Palace, including meetings and appointments with the president and advisors like Marco Aurélio Santana ('Marcola').

item.title: Flávio e Lula aceleram estratégias para tentar levar às urnas 33 milhões de faltosos
item.description: The 2026 presidential election recorded the narrowest margin between finalists (Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula) and the highest abstention rate in the decade, with 33.4 million voters absent. Both campaigns prioritize mobilizing non-voters, particularly youth and low-literacy groups, to influence the runoff.

item.title: Avanço pela direita: Republicanos vira peça central de seu campo no xadrez eleitoral do país
item.description: The Brazilian Republican Party (Republicanos) has strengthened its position as a key player on the right-wing political landscape, governing one-third of the national electorate after victories in São Paulo, Minas Gerais, and Mato Grosso. With strategic alliances, particularly with the PL, the party expands its influence in Congress and prepares for potential ministerial roles in a future government.

item.title: Fim da 6x1 faz Lula repetir gesto de Ulysses Guimarães
item.description: Lula repeated a historic gesture by Ulysses Guimarães while promoting a labor reform bill in Congress, amid criticism over suspected media coverage bias during a second-round interview. The Noblat program highlighted Flávio Bolsonaro's double speech and tied polls showing a technical draw between candidates.

item.title: O agro no vermelho: setor mais pujante da economia se vê ameaçado por crise de crédito
item.description: The Brazilian agribusiness sector faces a credit crisis and record default rates due to high interest rates, affecting producers and companies, with increased bankruptcy filings and job losses in the sector.

item.title: Amiga de Lulinha levanta suspeita sobre acidente da filha e cita Lula
item.description: Lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger raised suspicions about a car accident involving one of her daughters and controversially attributed responsibility to President Lula (PT). In an interview with CNN Brasil, she claimed any harm to her or her daughters would be blamed on Lula, without providing concrete evidence. The allegations sparked media and political debate in Brazil.

item.title: Horário do debate da band: veja como assistir debate entre Lula e Flávio ao vivo
item.description: Band broadcasts live at 8 PM the first direct debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, marking a significant confrontation in the 2026 presidential race. The event will be aired simultaneously across multiple networks.

item.title: Copa do Mundo Feminina Sub-17: veja grupos, formato e jogos do Brasil
item.description: The 2026 FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup kicked off in Morocco with 24 teams in a new annual format. Brazil, led by Rilany Silva, competes against traditional powers like North Korea and Japan, aiming to improve upon their fourth-place finish in 2025.

item.title: "Atos dia 18": artistas são orientados a usar branco e evitar Lula no palco
item.description: Artists and cultural movements organize pro-democracy rallies in five Brazilian capitals, with guidance to avoid mentioning Lula and wear white shirts. Opposition parties and Novo Party challenge the legality of the mobilizations, filing a lawsuit with the electoral court. The events feature performances by Caetano Veloso, Daniela Mercury and Gilberto Gil, focusing on social rights advocacy.

item.title: Erika Hilton, diputada: “Puede haber un golpe en Brasil. Esta vez dentro de la ley, no aquel show del horror”
item.description: Federal deputy Erika Hilton attends a public event in São Paulo, where she is greeted enthusiastically by young people and supporters. In her speech, she warns about the possibility of a coup d'état in Brazil, noting that if it happens, it will be 'within the law', unlike the grotesque spectacle of 2023. The journalist highlights the polarization and tense political climate in the country.

item.title: Lula entre o mea-culpa e o que 'a população merece'
item.description: Lula took full responsibility for the government's low approval rating in an interview with Renata Lo Prete, acknowledging mistakes and asking forgiveness from the public.

item.title: A microeconomia de Lula
item.description: In a Globo interview, President Lula emphasized that economic growth hinges on microeconomics, criticizing wealth concentration and advocating for money circulation among the population. He warned that inequality will persist if assets remain concentrated in the hands of a few.

item.title: Saiba quem é o empresário Amauri Pinha, citado por Luschsinger
item.description: Amauri Pinha, president of ECB's Board of Directors (part of Mota-Engil Group), was cited by lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger as close to Fábio Lula, son of the president, raising questions about R$2 billion contracts between the company and the federal government.

item.title: Meta tem de zelar por equilíbrio na campanha eleitoral
item.description: The Brazilian Superior Electoral Court (TSE) ordered Meta to maintain balance in political content distribution during the 2026 elections, following Lula's campaign complaint about preferential treatment for Flávio Bolsonaro. The ruling aims to ensure fair play and prevent algorithmic manipulation through tools like Meta AI. Although no deliberate intent was found, the court emphasized its oversight role in electoral processes.

item.title: Vox Brasil: com empate técnico, Lula tem 46,4% e Flávio Bolsonaro 44,6%
item.description: The Vox Brasil/Arte/Metrópoles poll shows a technical tie between Lula (46.4%) and Flávio Bolsonaro (44.6%) in the 2026 presidential runoff, with a 2.15 percentage point margin of error. The survey, conducted from October 15 to 17, interviewed 2,100 people and is registered with the TSE.

item.title: Lula tem 51% contra 49% de Flávio em votos válidos, diz Vox
item.description: A Vox Brasil poll shows Lula leading with 51% against Flávio Bolsonaro's 49% in valid votes, within the margin of error. Both candidates have high rejection rates at 45.3%. The survey was conducted from October 15-17 with 2,100 voters and a margin of error of 2.15 points.

item.title: Lula tem 51% dos votos válidos, e Flávio Bolsonaro, 49%, diz pesquisa Vox Brasil
item.description: A survey by Instituto Vox Brasil shows Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leading with 51% of valid votes against Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 49% for the presidential runoff, a margin within the margin of error. The poll also reflects a slight improvement in the approval rating of President Lula and greater public expectation of his victory in the race.

item.title: Confira o que Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula levaram para a propaganda eleitoral no rádio neste 2º turno
item.description: According to a g1 analysis, the second-round campaigns of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro focused on mutual attacks and themes such as 'change' and 'end of the 6-to-1 score'. Lula emphasized fears of the Bolsonaro family returning to power, while Flávio highlighted the transformation discourse. The radio ads were registered with the TSE between October 8 and 15.

item.title: No Instagram, Lula muda o discurso no segundo turno, e Flávio Bolsonaro mantém foco em voto e confronto
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro use Instagram differently in the runoff, with the president increasing mentions of his rival and the senator keeping voting and confrontation messages. The analysis of 2,129 posts shows a role reversal since pre-campaign.

item.title: Alcolumbre conta votos e traça planos para seguir no comando do Senado em governo de Lula ou de Flávio
item.description: Davi Alcolumbre intensified his campaign for re-election to the Senate presidency in 2027, despite opposition from the PL and the launch of Rogério Marinho as a candidate. The race escalated after Alcolumbre removed the Public Security Amendment Bill from the agenda, triggering an exchange of accusations with Marinho. Alcolumbre’s strategy focuses on splitting PL votes, leveraging alliances with senators like Eduardo Gomes.
